def _append_params(oauth_params, params):
    """Append OAuth params to a list of params or a form-encoded body string."""
    # If params is a string, extract the params from it
    if isinstance(params, (str, bytes)):
        params = extract_params(params) or []
    
    # Separate non-oauth and oauth params from each list
    non_oauth_params = [p for p in params if not p[0].startswith('oauth_')]
    oauth_in_params = [p for p in params if p[0].startswith('oauth_')]
    
    non_oauth_oauth_params = [p for p in oauth_params if not p[0].startswith('oauth_')]
    oauth_in_oauth_params = [p for p in oauth_params if p[0].startswith('oauth_')]
    
    return (non_oauth_params + non_oauth_oauth_params + 
            oauth_in_params + oauth_in_oauth_params)
